resources.string: VisualTaste TV
Welcome screen
Ready to greet guests when the TV turns on
Set up the welcome screen. It will appear every time the TV turns on, and guests can leave it with the Back button.
1. Pairing code
You will find it in the VisualTaste admin: Guide, the apartment, TV screen.
Code
Check
Type the code first.
Checking…
Paired with %1$s
That code does not exist or the TV is turned off in the admin.
Could not reach VisualTaste. Check the TV\'s internet connection and try again.
2. Allow it to appear when the TV turns on
In the screen that opens, turn on VisualTaste TV under \"Display over other apps\". Then come back with the Back button.
Open settings
Allowed
Not allowed yet: the screen will not appear on its own.
Android saves this setting with a delay. If you will unplug the TV in the next half hour, restart it first from Settings.
If the switch is greyed out or will not turn on: open the app\'s page, choose \"Allow restricted settings\" and try again.
Open app page
This TV does not let us open that setting. Look for \"Display over other apps\" in Settings, Apps, Special app access.
3. On TCL TVs
Open the Safety guard app, then Permission shield, Auto launch permission. Turn off \"Auto manager\" and turn on VisualTaste TV. Without this, TCL stops it from opening by itself.
Start
To come back here later, hold the Back button for 3 seconds on the welcome screen.
